mapper.select: WITH RECURSIVE subtree AS ( SELECT d.* FROM sys_dept d WHERE d.dept_id = #{departmentId} AND d.deleted = 0 AND d.status = 0 UNION ALL SELECT child.* FROM sys_dept child INNER JOIN subtree parent ON child.parent_id = parent.dept_id WHERE child.deleted = 0 AND child.status = 0 ) SELECT * FROM subtree
